title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 18 in G-sharp minor

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a third every bar.

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted and the opening of the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times). Returns in Episode 4 (bars 28–32).

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence rising by a fifth every half bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar.

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 13–15), with the tenor's line in the bass, a fourth lower. Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted and the opening of the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (5 times), in a sequence rising by a fifth every half bar.

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject and the opening of the subject.

sections.label: Subject in C♯ minor, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject.
